target.title: Add deep regression review prototype
target.body:
Closes #439.

## TLDR

- Adds a default-off OpenClaw deep-regression review prototype for high-risk PRs.
- GitNexus is optional and advisory. GitHub diff/checkout context remains authoritative.
- All concrete ClawSweeper findings found during this PR loop are fixed on the current head.
- Final local-range proof is clean: patch correct, no review findings, security cleared, no deep-regression concerns.
- Remote CI is green on the current head, including `pnpm check`.
- No 1M-context or release-safety claim is made. Context-window size is telemetry only.

Current head: `caf54ba268bf6733347daf6cae62a45a2affb697`

## What Changed

- Adds deterministic OpenClaw high-risk classification for core/runtime/auth/session/security/provider-routing/release/config surfaces.
- Adds an optional GitNexus advisory context packet behind `CLAWSWEEPER_GITNEXUS_CONTEXT=1`.
- Adds packet freshness, exact packet SHA, stable content SHA, byte budget, omitted-context accounting, redaction hash, and fail-closed behavior for secret-like output.
- Extends the decision schema, prompt contract, report frontmatter, public rendering, and close/automation gating with `deepRegressionReview`.
- Adds context-window telemetry via `CLAWSWEEPER_EXPECTED_CONTEXT_WINDOW_TOKENS`; unknown stays `unknown`.
- Adds review-cache safety so graph-context changes bust cached reports, while identical graph context generated at different times can reuse prior review content.
- Adds command-status cleanup so repeated `@clawsweeper re-review` commands do not leave stale ClawSweeper status comments for older heads.
- Adds maintainer-facing documentation: `docs/deep-regression-review.md`.

## ClawSweeper Finding Map

ClawSweeper used several `[P1]` labels across proof guidance, risk notes, and maintainer options. The actionable items found during this PR loop are now handled as follows:

| Finding / gate | Resolution |
| --- | --- |
| Raw GitNexus failure output could reach prompt/report fields | Fixed. Nonzero `gitnexus list/query` output is omitted and represented by status plus output hash; secret-like output fails closed. |
| GitNexus context missing from review cache state | Fixed. The review content digest includes graph enabled/freshness/content hash/alias/stale-policy/context-window state. |
| Packet hash was unstable because it included `generatedAt` | Fixed. Packet `sha256` remains exact evidence; `contentSha256` excludes run-local telemetry and is used for cache state. |
| Deep-regression blockers could still emit pass markers | Fixed. `blocked` or `needs_attention` deep-regression concerns now force `needs-human` markers and cannot pass automerge/autofix marker gates. |
| GitNexus packet building applied to non-OpenClaw PRs | Fixed. Packet building and graph-specific cache state are scoped to `openclaw/openclaw`. |
| Maintainer GitNexus/schema boundary | Committed as a proposed contract in `docs/deep-regression-review.md`; maintainers can accept, narrow, or remove it in normal review. |
| Live proof | Added. Final local-range proof for `caf54ba` reports patch correct with no review findings. |

## GitNexus In Plain English

GitNexus is an optional code graph/index. In this PR, ClawSweeper can use it for related-code hints:

- Which symbols or files are near the changed files?
- What other code paths may depend on this area?
- Is the local graph fresh, stale, missing, or unsafe to use?

It does not decide the review. It does not replace the PR diff. It does not guarantee release safety. It is a bounded advisory packet that helps ClawSweeper state what context it used and where confidence should be lower.

## Flow

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["PR changes arrive"] --> B["Read GitHub diff and live checkout"]
  B --> C["Classify OpenClaw risk surface"]
  C --> D{"Target is openclaw/openclaw and GitNexus enabled?"}
  D -- "No" --> E["Graph state = not_applicable"]
  D -- "Yes" --> F["Build advisory graph packet"]
  F --> G{"Packet safe and fresh enough?"}
  G -- "Yes" --> H["Record packet SHA and stable content SHA"]
  G -- "No" --> I["Degrade, omit, or fail closed"]
  E --> J["Compute review cache digest"]
  H --> J
  I --> J
  J --> K{"Cached report still valid?"}
  K -- "Yes" --> L["Reuse report"]
  K -- "No" --> M["Run fresh review"]
  M --> N["Render deepRegressionReview and proof boundary"]
  L --> N
  N --> O{"Deep-regression blocker?"}
  O -- "Yes" --> P["Emit needs-human markers"]
  O -- "No" --> Q["Normal marker policy"]
```

## Validation

Latest local validation on `caf54ba268bf6733347daf6cae62a45a2affb697`:

```text
pnpm run build
node --test test/pr-review-comment-risk.test.ts test/review-content-cache.test.ts test/gitnexus-context.test.ts test/decision-parser.test.ts
pnpm run format:check
pnpm run lint:src
git diff --check
```

Result:

```text
targeted tests: 70 pass, 0 fail
build: pass
format/lint/diff-check: pass
```

Local-range proof on `caf54ba`:

```text
review_status: complete
decision: keep_open
confidence: high
overallCorrectness: patch is correct
reviewFindings: []
securityReview: cleared
deepRegressionReview: not_applicable, concerns: []
gitnexus_context_freshness: not_applicable
context_budget_status: within_budget
```

Evidence packet: `/Volumes/LEXAR/Codex/evidence/clawsweeper-deep-regression/2026-07-09/issue-439/local-range-caf54ba/`

Remote validation on `caf54ba`:

- `pnpm check`: pass
- Windows Codex launcher: pass
- CodeQL: pass
- Socket checks: pass
- Merge state: clean

## Non-goals

- No OpenClaw runtime changes.
- No automatic merge or release gates by default.
- No public 1M-context claim.
- No release-safety or bug-free guarantee.
- No GitNexus auto-refresh in this PR.
- No embedded GitNexus index storage or embedding credentials.

## Proof Boundary

This prototype improves advisory review signal and confidence hygiene. It proves the seeded/cache/redaction/marker/unit cases, final local-range review, and remote CI covered above. It does not prove release readiness, bug-free releases, actual 1M-token context, or that GitNexus context is authoritative over the GitHub diff/checkout.

## Remaining Maintainer Decision

The remaining decision is product/security-boundary acceptance, not an unresolved code bug: should ClawSweeper carry this default-off deep-regression + advisory GitNexus contract in core? The committed docs propose yes, with GitNexus disabled by default and production enablement gated by the checklist in `docs/deep-regression-review.md`.

Note: the durable ClawSweeper GitHub review comment is currently stale for this head. I did not dispatch another GitHub re-review because prior command-triggered re-reviews created noisy ack/status comments; the current source of truth is this PR body, the linked issue body, the local-range evidence packet, and green CI.
